Energy Levels Text: Due to the oestrogen and progesterone suppressing gluconeogensis your body will burn fat and not sugar, but this will make excercise feel harder. Due to this you will feel lower in energy and get tired quicker. It is recomended to do lower intensity workouts and strength sessions.
Type of food: During this phase it is best to eat carbs and proteins, as when doing excercies it will make your body rely on glucose less. Foods rich with vitamin B and healthy facts will also help to support hormonal balance, and therefore are recommended.
